title: Deacons
definition: Deacons are qualified servants who help meet practical needs so the Church may be strengthened in mercy, unity, and ministry.
summary: Deacons are qualified servants who help meet practical needs so the church's ministry remains ordered, compassionate, and faithful.
christFocus: Jesus Christ modeled servant-hearted ministry and calls His people to serve with humility.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on recognized service. Deacons protect the church from neglect by attending to practical needs, mercy concerns, logistics, and care that support the Word and prayer. Their ministry shows that practical service is spiritual when done for Christ and His people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because overlooked needs can quietly wound a congregation. Deacons help ensure that the vulnerable are served and that unity is preserved through wise administration. They dignify humble, practical labor in the body of Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Honor practical servants who often work without attention. Pray for deacons to have wisdom, compassion, and integrity. Look for ways your own practical abilities can relieve burdens in the church.
